title: Unique generator-normalized scalar composition
statement: On a site satisfying the SystemScalarModel sheafification and smallness assumptions, let phi:R→S, psi:S→T and gamma:R→T satisfy gamma=phi≫psi. For SystemScalarModels A,B,D for these maps, there is a unique isomorphism A.model.E⋙B.model.E≅D.model.E which sends the iterated tensor c tensor (b tensor x) to (c*psi(b)) tensor x on every section. The definitions and hypotheses are as in [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model].

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex 06YY. Exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text:
Use the existing scalar composition isomorphism and its pure tensor equation for
existence. For uniqueness transpose under the second ordinary adjunction, then use local unit
tensor generators for the first model. Both transposes agree on these generators by the two
specified tensor formulas and the normalized unit equation.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCompositionUnique
    {R S T : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{sw}} {φ : R ⟶ S} {ψ : S ⟶ T} {γ : R ⟶ T}
    (hγ : γ = φ ≫ ψ)
    (A : SheafOfModules.SystemScalarModel φ) (B : SheafOfModules.SystemScalarModel ψ)
    (D : SheafOfModules.SystemScalarModel γ) :
    ∃! a : A.model.E ⋙ B.model.E ≅ D.model.E,
      ∀ P U (c : T.obj.obj U) (b : S.obj.obj U) (x : P.val.obj U),
        (a.hom.app P).val.app U
          (SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul B.model (A.model.E.obj P) U c
            (SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul A.model P U b x)) =
          SheafOfModules.systemModelTmul D.model P U (c * (ψ.hom.app U) b) x
